title: Near-duplicate detection at scale
one_line: Find near-duplicate groups among N items and pick one survivor per group, without comparing every pair.

recognition_signals.observable: dedup job runtime grows ~4x when input doubles
exact-hash/DISTINCT dedup is clean but duplicates persist downstream
output changes when the input is shuffled
a duplicate cluster contains items a human calls unrelated
a small threshold change causes a large swing in removal count
recognition_signals.implies: operating on the LSH knee, where retrieval at your own threshold is well below certainty

CORRECTION.status: SCOPED -- figure inherited from the retracted divisor model; the observable itself is confirmed and strong

recognition_signals.observable: cost dominated by comparison, not embedding generation

constraints.claim: recall AT the requested threshold is far below 1.0 -- about 0.42, not ~1.0 That means the threshold names where the S-curve is centred rather than a recall floor, so do not quote it to a caller as a guarantee.

measured_on.what: real datasketch 2.0.0 MinHash objects, 600 synthetic pairs built to a known Jaccard. The (b,r) split is whatever datasketch selects, not one chosen by hand.

constraints.generalizes: the MECHANISM generalises -- retrieval at the requested threshold is far below certainty for any caller. The FIGURE is specific to threshold 0.70 at num_perm=128 and must be recomputed for other settings. That means the mechanism licenses a design rule while the figure licenses nothing outside its own setting, so never carry the number to a different num_perm.

CORRECTION.status: SCOPED -- the number was right for a configuration datasketch never selects
CORRECTION.why: (16,8) is a divisor pair of 128, chosen under the retracted b*r == num_perm assumption. datasketch selects (14,9) for threshold 0.70. (16,8) is in fact its choice for threshold 0.65, so the old figure was attached to the wrong threshold.
CORRECTION.effect: the old figure UNDERSTATED the problem by about 45%. The correction makes the hazard larger, not smaller.
CORRECTION.root_cause_shared_with: C3 and A4, both retracted the same day. One wrong premise contaminated three claims.

constraints.claim: measured reduction on the 80-doc fixture, at the banding datasketch actually selects

measured_on.what: the same 80-document synthetic fixture; reduction factor is fixture-specific and grows with N on any corpus

constraints.generalizes: NO as a value, and the DIRECTION of the error matters. 32.6x is this 80-document fixture's reduction, and the factor GROWS with N: quoting it at large N understates the benefit, quoting it at small N invents one. This figure has been over-generalised in practice, which is why it carries this field at all. ORDER OF OPERATIONS, corrected after a consumer run -- do these in this order, because the first step can end the question: (1) Check the corpus-size entry in do_not_use_when. If N is below that breakpoint, STOP. A reduction factor cannot justify LSH at any magnitude on a corpus small enough to scan exhaustively, so computing the factor is wasted work and quoting one is worse than wasted. (2) ONLY if you clear that gate, compute the reduction for YOUR N from P(candidate) = 1 - (1 - s**rows)**bands at the bands and rows you actually intend to deploy, and weigh it against the cost of the exhaustive scan you would otherwise run -- not against this fixture's 32.6x.
constraints.correction_provenance: The previous wording of this field inverted these two steps: it asked the reader to compute the reduction, then closed by noting that a large reduction on a small corpus is not a benefit -- which makes the computation it had just requested unable to change the decision. A naive consumer run (SC-02, opus-class, exposure=none) checked the cheap disqualifying gate, concluded the reduction was moot, and skipped the arithmetic. That was correct behaviour against a mis-ordered instruction, and it is the reason this field now states the order explicitly. Recorded because the defect class is reusable: an instruction whose own justification clause removes the need for the action it requests reads as thorough and executes as redundant.

CORRECTION.status: FOUR OF FIVE VALUES CORRECTED -- all were measured at bands=16, rows=8
CORRECTION.why: (16,8) is a divisor pair of 128, selected under the retracted b*r == num_perm premise. datasketch selects (14,9) for threshold 0.70.
CORRECTION.direction: reduction_factor is HIGHER (56.43 vs 32.6) because (14,9) is more selective, and recall is LOWER (35/40 vs 38/40). The card was optimistic on recall and pessimistic on reduction.
CORRECTION.only_survivor: naive_comparisons = 3160 = C(80,2), which does not depend on the banding.
CORRECTION.now_pinned_by: tests/test_pc0001.py::test_blocking_actually_reduces_work, and the selection itself is cross-checked against real datasketch by test_selection_agrees_with_real_datasketch

constraints.claim: the band/row split datasketch selects lands near but not exactly on the requested threshold -- typically within about 0.06 That means the achieved threshold sits near the requested one rather than on it, so a test must not assert equality.

measured.reachable_pairs: 645 at num_perm=128 and 1466 at num_perm=256 -- the space is DENSE

measured_on.what: local reimplementation of datasketch.lsh._optimal_param, which searches every (b,r) with b*r <= num_perm and minimises a weighted FP/FN integral. No corpus involved.

constraints.generalizes: YES for the mechanism -- any caller gets a nearby rather than exact split. The MAGNITUDE (~0.06) was measured at num_perm=128 over thresholds 0.50-0.95 and should be recomputed for other num_perm rather than assumed. That means the offset is a property of the selected band/row split, which is why it has to be recomputed rather than carried across settings.

RETRACTION.previous_claim: reachable knees are quantized by the divisors of num_perm, giving only 8 knees at num_perm=128, with distinct requested thresholds collapsing to identical behaviour and errors up to 0.107.
RETRACTION.retracted_on: discovery that datasketch's _optimal_param constrains b*r <= num_perm, NOT b*r == num_perm
RETRACTION.how_wrong: the reachable space is 645 pairs at num_perm=128, not 8. 0.80/0.85/0.90 select three DIFFERENT pairs, not one. 0.60 and 0.70 select different pairs. There is no collapse and no no-op.
RETRACTION.the_prior_caveat_was_the_tell: the card previously stated that the nearest-knee model 'is not datasketch's selection objective' and then asserted quantization was 'unaffected'. The first half named the fatal objection; the second half waved it away. A caveat that identifies the flaw and dismisses it is worse than none, because it makes the claim look stress-tested.
RETRACTION.how_it_was_caught: a card-consuming model, asked to review a real threshold change, tested the card's claim against the actual config, reported the correct b/r pairs, and contradicted the card. Verified by local reimplementation.
RETRACTION.removed_advice: a suggested-num_perm table (120 at 0.60, 144 at 0.70, 180 at 0.80) claiming 15x/2.2x/39x error improvements. Under the real selector those switches make the gap WORSE at 0.60 (0.0617->0.0671) and at 0.80 (0.0445->0.0473), and give 1.3x not 2.2x at 0.70. It advised spending more memory for less accuracy and is deleted.

wall_clock.note: first draft claimed ~6 days at 1ns for N=1e6; wrong by 1000x, that is the 1us figure

breakpoints.action: use the naive scan; simpler and fast enough
distribute stage 1 by band bucket; stages 2-4 parallelise per bucket

anti_patterns.name: union-find over similar pairs (transitive chaining)
anti_patterns.why: single-linkage is transitive: A~B=0.9, B~C=0.9, A~C=0.2 yields one cluster That means a pair far below your threshold can still be merged through an intermediate, so single-linkage cannot be described as enforcing the threshold it was given.

anti_patterns.name: treating a band collision as a duplicate
anti_patterns.why: LSH is a recall device; skipping exact scoring imports its false-positive rate permanently

anti_patterns.name: keep the first
anti_patterns.why: makes output a function of input order

anti_patterns.name: assuming the requested threshold is the effective one
anti_patterns.why: see C3 -- the selected split lands near, not on, the requested value, and nothing in the library reports what it chose
anti_patterns.fix: print lsh.b and lsh.r after construction and compute the actual knee (1/b)^(1/r); treat that as your real threshold. Do NOT change num_perm hoping to close the gap -- measure first, because it often does not help.

RETRACTION.previous_name: tuning a threshold without checking it is expressible
RETRACTION.previous_fleet_check: CONFIRMED -- 0 of 11 real configs request an exactly reachable threshold; distinct requested thresholds collapse to identical behaviour, so a threshold ablation can compare a value against itself.
RETRACTION.status: the COLLAPSE half is RETRACTED AS FALSE. Distinct thresholds select distinct splits. A threshold ablation does NOT compare a value against itself.
RETRACTION.what_survives: the weaker true claim that the effective threshold differs from the requested one by roughly 0.06 at num_perm=128, and that the library does not report the split it chose. The verify-what-you-got advice stands; the change-num_perm advice does not.
RETRACTION.note: the arithmetic behind the retracted claim was executed, reproducible, and run on real harvested configs. All of that was true and none of it saved the finding, because it answered the wrong question. Reproducibility is not validity.

anti_patterns.name: reporting only the count of duplicates removed
anti_patterns.why: high for both a good run and a chaining catastrophe
anti_patterns.fix: also report cluster count, max cluster size, max intra-cluster distance

do_not_use_when: exact duplicates only (hashing is correct and cheaper)
a high-precision deterministic blocking key exists (Shape C)
similarity is vector-shaped with an existing ANN index (Shape B)
per-pair decisions must be auditable (LSH misses are probabilistic)

escalation.symptom: recall too low at acceptable cost
escalation.action: move the knee below threshold; let stage 2 reject extras
raise the knee, or pre-block with Shape C before stage 1
A1: switch to representative_link; check max_intra_cluster_distance

escalation.symptom: recall must be provable not probabilistic
escalation.action: leave this card; exact blocking + full within-block comparison
